flashcards.back: Define mixtures, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define handpicking and sieving, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore mixtures
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on mixtures. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where handpicking and sieving is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach separation choices to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
